text:
jamie: Quick porch update — trying a hammock WFH for the afternoon. lazy light + ficus = bliss. photos: (1/3)
alex: omg jealous. how's the Wi‑Fi out there? :eyes:
jamie: fine until the afternoon thunder rolled in. ISP dropped for ~3m. had to switch to phone hotspot. not great for big deploys :grimacing:
jamie: small router logs:
```
Apr 5 15:02:31 kernel: br0: link is down
Apr 5 15:02:34 ppp0: PAP authentication succeeded
Apr 5 15:05:12 dhcp_client: lease renewed
```
alex: yikes. hope no packet loss on the VPN. did infra-bot see anything?
infra-bot: [status] 1865001250 - ISP outage detected in zone us-west-2. More info: https://status.example.com/incidents/322 :information_source:
jamie: thanks — that matches. VPN ping jumped to ~220ms during the blip. back to ~35ms now.
samar: hammock sounds amazing. pro tip: put a small foldable table on the left for keyboard + drink. also, phone hotspot trick: set your tether AP to 5GHz for less interference.
zoe: unrelated but the porch plant is thriving! new baby leaves this week. homeroom terrarium proud mom :seedling:
alex: can we get a porch tour when you inevitably make it desktop setup #5? :joy:
jamie: sure — later today i'll post a mini carousel. also FYI i'll avoid big deploy windows if storms in forecast. :thumbsup:
alex: smart. enjoy the fresh air!
